title: def sf verdier hom composition coordinates
statement: Fix a six-functor operation datum S and one of its four coefficient stages s. On each finite-Tor full subcategory use a supplied PodCtfAdjunctionData presentation. TensorPresentationNatural is naturality in the first tensor factor of its comparison with the recorded partial tensor. Define chain as the inverse of the five-bijection PodHomChain.homEquiv, and forward by evaluating it at the identity. Define epsilon by forward followed by the direct image of the internal-Hom map induced by the supplied dualizing comparison. For composable f,g and a presentation for their composite, supportComposition and pullComposition are the fully faithful restrictions of the specified ambient compositors. directComposition and exceptionalComposition are the canonical rightAdjointUniq mates for these restricted left-adjoint compositors. sourceCoordinate first applies the exceptional compositor inside Hom, then the direct compositor. targetCoordinate applies contravariant internal Hom to the inverse support compositor. ChainComposition is equality of the one-map and two successive forward chains at every test arrow in these coordinates; dualizingComposition and VerdierComposition specialize the same formula with the supplied dualizing maps. tensorCoordinate is eqToIso for equality of closed tensor presentations. All existing constructions are preserved literally; no existence witness or new choice is used.

def TensorPresentationNatural (W : SixFunctorSpace D)
    (C : SixFunctorClosedDomain (PodCoefficientStage.domain S s W)
      (PodCoefficientStage.homPairs (S := S) s W)
      (PodCoefficientStage.internalHom (S := S) s W))
    (tensor : ∀ K : (PodCoefficientStage.domain S s W).FullSubcategory,
      @MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft _ _ C.closed.monoidal K ⋙
        (PodCoefficientStage.domain S s W).ι ≅ (PodCoefficientStage.tensor S s W).obj K.obj) :
    Prop
